rules.true_faces_only: Every pair must share a finite face in the periodic 60-cell Voronoi graph.
rules.exclude_sigma: Any pair whose modulo-30 source pair occurs in Sigma/TWIN_FACE_PAIRS is forbidden, including cross-layer images.
rules.disjoint_pairs: Within one design each grain occurs in at most one controlled CSL pair.
rules.background: All unpaired grains use reproducible independent orientations and their own phase anchors.
